component.name: SaruSaru Recomp
component.summary: Native port of Saru! Get You! SaruSaru Daisakusen

description.p: An unofficial, fan-made native port of the PSP game Saru! Get You! SaruSaru Daisakusen (UCJS10060). It contains no game files: choose your own disc image of the Japanese UMD, and the launcher builds the game for your computer from it the first time you play.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
